### Title: THE APPLICATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN CRIMINAL PROCEDURE

Authors: Monika Porwisz  
Published in journal: 2025-06-25  

---

### 🪄 Explained Simply
Based on our analysis we propose that AI should primarily support judges during trial preparation by assisting them in selecting evidence and determining its weight; it could also help prosecutors prepare cases more efficiently while ensuring compliance with procedural requirements. In addition, AI may facilitate communication between courts and other authorities involved in criminal procedures, e.g., prisons, probation offices, and police departments. Finally, AI has great potential when used to analyse large volumes of data collected throughout various stages of criminal proceeding, including investigation, detention, court hearings, sentencing, execution of penalties, and release. This technology will enable faster identification of patterns, trends, correlations, inconsistencies, contradictions, gaps, and anomalies than would otherwise be possible using traditional methods. Our findings suggest that these applications have significant implications for the future development of criminal justice systems around the world.

---

### 📄 Original Abstract
The purpose of this paper is to identify areas in which artificial intelligence (AI) can be applied in criminal procedure, with a view to improving the efficiency of proceedings in terms of both time and cost. Addressing the issues raised required a review of international and Polish regulations concerning the definition and conceptual use of AI, as well as a review of the relevant literature. The areas analysed were essential for indicating the directions for the application of AI in criminal procedure and for justifying the need to implement the proposed solutions in line with existing legal standards.
